Plant cell plasma membrane known ion channels: K+ channels, Ca2+ channels, Cl- channels. Mg2+? Not typically known plasma membrane ion channel? There are Mg transporters/channels? Known anion channels include Cl-; cation channels K+ and Ca2+. So B. Need final line 答案：B.

content:
解析：在植物细胞质膜上，已知并研究较多的离子通道主要包括钾离子通道（$K^+$ 通道）、钙离子通道（$Ca^{2+}$ 通道）和阴离子通道（如 $Cl^-$ 通道）。而 $Mg^{2+}$、$Zn^{2+}$、$Fe^{2+}$ 等并不是质膜上典型已知的通道离子类型。

因此，正确选项是 B。

答案：B
